papers.title: Selective Laser Melting of the Eutectic Silver-Copper Alloy Ag 28 wt % Cu
papers.abstract: RTeJournal - Fachforum fur Rapid Technologie, Vol. 2016, Iss. 1 - The aim of this work was to perform a detailed investigation of the use of Selective Laser Melting (SLM) technology to process eutectic silver-copper alloy Ag 28 wt. % Cu (also called AgCu28). The processing occurred with a Realizer SLM 50 desktop machine. The powder analysis (SEM-topography, EDX, particle distribution) was reported as well as the absorption rates for the near-infrared (NIR) spectrum. Microscope imaging showed the surface topography of the manufactured parts. Furthermore, microsections were conducted for the analysis of porosity. The Design of Experiments approach used the response surface method in order to model the statistical relationship between laser power, spot distance and pulse time.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究银铜共晶合金的选区激光熔化工艺，与生物医用植入体方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on SLM processing of a non-biomedical alloy (AgCu28) with no mention of porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, mechanical testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究银铜共晶合金AgCu28的SLM成形工艺。
summary_zh.method: 采用响应面法设计实验，分析激光功率、点距和脉冲时间的影响。
summary_zh.result: 获得了工艺参数与孔隙率、表面形貌的关系。
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微切片和SEM进行形貌与成分表征。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the selective laser melting process of eutectic silver-copper alloy Ag28wt%Cu.
summary_en.method: A design of experiments approach using response surface methodology was employed to model relationships between laser parameters (power, spot distance, pulse time) and part characteristics.
summary_en.result: The study established statistical correlations between processing parameters and resultant porosity and surface topography.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through microscopy and microsection analysis of manufactured samples.
